concerns.text: Phase 7 (Revision & Physical Validation) contains tasks T101-T107 which are NOT mapped to any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in spec.md. The spec defines FR-001 through FR-008 and SC-001 through SC-003, all of which are covered in Phases 1-6. Phase 7 tasks appear to be derived from external 'research-stage reviews' (Einstein, Curie, etc.) mentioned in the task descriptions but have no corresponding requirement in the spec.md. This creates a 'stale tag' scenario where tasks exist for requirements that do not exist in the current spec, or conversely, the spec is missing the requirements these tasks implement. Per FR-001/FR-008 coverage, these tasks are orphaned.

Task T101 ('Define Physical Ground Truth') claims to address 'Marie Curie's and Rosalind Franklin's concern' but has no [FR-NNN] or [SC-NNN] tag. The spec.md FR-001 only requires fetching/checksumming. There is no FR requiring validation of 'measured vs theoretical' nature of data values. This task implements a requirement not present in the spec.

Task T102 ('Implement Structural Constraint Validation') enforces peptide planarity and H-bond geometry. No FR in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-008) mandates these specific geometric constraints for the generic 'Experimental barrier dataset'. The task is unlinked to any spec requirement.

Task T103 ('Quantify Approximation Error Budget') requires FLOP estimation and basis set truncation documentation. No FR or SC in spec.md requires this. FR-007 and SC-003 are strictly about sensitivity sweeps (cutoffs/noise). This task is orphaned.
Task T104 ('Map Descriptors to Physical Observables') requires linking descriptors to physical observables. No FR/SC in spec.md mandates this mapping. This task is orphaned.

Task T105 ('Hydration & Solvent Model Check') requires checking solvent parameters. The spec.md Data Model and Assumptions do not mention solvent metadata. No FR/SC requires this check. This task is orphaned.

Task T106 ('Error Bar Quantification') requires calculating error bars against experimental uncertainty. While SC-002 mentions MAE, it does not require explicit error bars or comparison to experimental uncertainty metadata. No FR/SC explicitly mandates this. This task is orphaned.

Task T107 ('Physical Interpretability Test Case') requires tracing predictions to electron density/path integrals. US3 and SC-003 define success solely by statistical rank correlation. No FR/SC authorizes this level of physical interpretability visualization. This task is orphaned.

Phase 7 tasks (T101-T107) are tagged with [P] (Parallel) but lack any [FR-NNN] or [SC-NNN] tags. The task descriptions reference 'research-stage reviews' (Einstein, Curie, etc.) as the source of requirements, but these are not formalized in spec.md. This indicates a disconnect between the spec and the task plan, likely due to an unmerged spec update or a plan that anticipates requirements not yet written.
